steps.en: Register at tushare.pro and copy the token from the personal centre
steps.zh: 在 tushare.pro 注册，从个人中心复制 token

steps.en: Install the SDK, save the token once and open the Pro API
steps.zh: 安装 SDK，把 token 存一次，初始化 Pro 接口

steps.en: Call an interface by name with your window
steps.zh: 按名调用接口，带上时间窗

steps.en: Validates the token, enforces the points tier's per-minute and row caps, runs the query
steps.zh: 校验 token，按积分档执行频次与行数上限，跑查询

steps.en: Returns a documented-field DataFrame; envelope code=2002 means your tier cannot open that interface
steps.zh: 返回有文档字段的 DataFrame；2002 即积分档不够

value.en: You stop parsing pages and chasing unannounced field changes — the price model is points and separate licences, not support tickets
value.zh: 不用再解析网页、追着无预告的字段变更跑——代价模型是积分与单独授权，而不是支持工单

sources: https://tushare.pro/document/1?doc_id=39 (token copied from 个人中心 → 账号与TOKEN; refresh revokes the old token)
